papers.title: FPTR: Feasibility-Preserving Transactional Refinement for Deadline-Constrained Joint Beam and Resource Allocation
papers.translated_title: FPTR：面向截止时间约束的联合波束与资源分配的可行性保持事务性精化
papers.author: Minghao Kong
papers.summary: Short-interval wireless schedulers must return a complete, feasible beam-and-resource allocation before each execution deadline, and a late or invalid output gives no utility in the current control cycle. Searching longer can increase transmitted traffic, but it may also miss the deadline or leave only an infeasible intermediate solution. We propose Feasibility-Preserving Transactional Refinement (FPTR), which always keeps a validated feasible allocation, the incumbent. Each refinement stage builds a separate candidate and leaves the incumbent unchanged. A candidate replaces the incumbent only if it is complete, passes the feasibility validator before its stage cutoff, and strictly improves the objective; otherwise it is discarded. Four refinement stages use this rule: buffer-aware resource selection, compatibility-group (CG) user sharing, beam-mask rebuilding from remaining demand, and joint reassignment of two resources. On 150 fixed synthetic instances, the full pipeline (Full) raises traffic by 3.83% on average over a lightweight beam-first reference and by 1.79% over its Base constructor. In a separate suite with matched inputs, Full exceeds six independent search baselines (ALNS, tabu search, GA, simulated annealing, iterated local search, and GRASP) by 6.68-8.35%, where outputs later than 100 ms receive zero utility. All 750 Full runs in the internal suite returned feasible allocations, and none exceeded 100 ms. Separating mandatory output construction from optional refinement lets spare computation time improve the allocation without endangering the incumbent. The open-source implementation supports independent reproduction.
papers.translated_summary: 短间隔无线调度器必须在每次执行截止时间之前返回完整、可行的波束与资源分配方案，迟交或无效的输出在当前控制周期内不产生任何效用。搜索时间更长可能增加传输流量，但也可能错过截止时间，或只留下一个不可行的中间解。我们提出可行性保持的事务式精化方法（Feasibility-Preserving Transactional Refinement，FPTR），它始终保留一个经过验证的可行分配方案，即现任解。每个精化阶段构建一个独立的候选解，并保持现任解不变。候选解只有在完整、在其阶段截止时间之前通过可行性验证器、并且严格改善目标函数时，才会替换现任解；否则被丢弃。四个精化阶段采用该规则：缓冲区感知的资源选择、兼容组（compatibility-group，CG）用户共享、基于剩余需求的波束掩码重建，以及两个资源的联合重新分配。在150个固定合成实例上，完整流水线（Full）相比轻量级波束优先参考方案平均提升流量3.83%，相比其Base构造器提升1.79%。在具有匹配输入的独立测试集中，Full相比六个独立搜索基线（ALNS、禁忌搜索、GA、模拟退火、迭代局部搜索和GRASP）高出6.68–8.35%，其中晚于100 ms的输出获得零效用。内部测试集中全部750次Full运行均返回可行分配，且均未超过100 ms。将强制输出构造与可选精化解耦，使空闲计算时间能够改善分配而不危及现任解。开源实现支持独立复现。

papers.title: Risk-Sensitive Non-Parametric and Kernel Bandits
papers.translated_title: 风险敏感的非参数与核bandits
papers.author: Devdan Dey
papers.summary: We study non-parametric bandits in which arms are evaluated using Cumulative Prospect Theory (CPT) rather than expected reward. We consider continuous action spaces with arm-dependent noise and propose Non-Parametric CPT Bandits ($\mathtt{NPCB}$), an optimistic algorithm that decouples mean estimation from CPT-based decision-making. We prove CPT regret of order $\widetilde{\mathcal O}\bigl(\sqrt{T\,\dim_E(\mathcal F,T^{-2})\,\log N(\mathcal F,T^{-2},\|\cdot\|_\infty)}\bigr)$, where $\dim_E$ is the Eluder dimension of the function class $\mathcal F$, $T$ is the time horizon, and $N$ is its covering number in the sup norm. This matches the order-wise regret of classical non-parametric bandits, showing that CPT risk sensitivity incurs no additional order-wise regret cost. We extend $\mathtt{NPCB}$ to unknown noise CDFs, retaining the known-CDF mean-learning term and adding a CDF-learning cost governed by a distributional Eluder dimension. We also study Kernel-CPT bandits and obtain information-gain-based regret bounds for a broad range of kernels, matching the corresponding risk-neutral kernel rates up to logarithmic factors.
papers.translated_summary: 我们研究非参数 bandit 问题，其中臂的评估采用累积前景理论（Cumulative Prospect Theory, CPT）而非期望奖励。我们考虑具有臂相关噪声的连续动作空间，并提出非参数 CPT Bandit（$\mathtt{NPCB}$），一种将均值估计与基于 CPT 的决策解耦的乐观算法。我们证明 CPT 遗憾界为 $\widetilde{\mathcal O}\bigl(\sqrt{T\,\dim_E(\mathcal F,T^{-2})\,\log N(\mathcal F,T^{-2},\|\cdot\|_\infty)}\bigr)$，其中 $\dim_E$ 是函数类 $\mathcal F$ 的 Eluder 维数，$T$ 是时间跨度，$N$ 是其在 sup 范数下的覆盖数。该结果与经典非参数 bandit 的阶数级遗憾相匹配，表明 CPT 风险敏感性不会带来额外的阶数级遗憾代价。我们将 $\mathtt{NPCB}$ 扩展到未知噪声 CDF 的情形，保留已知 CDF 的均值学习项，并加入由分布 Eluder 维数控制的 CDF 学习代价。我们还研究 Kernel-CPT bandit，并针对一大类核获得基于信息增益的遗憾界，在至多对数因子的意义下与相应的风险中性核速率相匹配。

papers.title: Model Merging Does Not Require Uniform LoRA Ranks
papers.translated_title: 模型合并不需要统一的LoRA秩
papers.author: Zirong Xie
papers.summary: Model merging combines separately fine-tuned experts into a single model without retraining. Standard practice trains every expert at the same LoRA rank, which couples the rank choice across experts even though each domain has its own best rank. We show this coupling is a property of the merge method, not of merging. We train 36 experts on three domains (mathematics, instruction following, multilingual) at four ranks and three model scales, then merge with six methods at uniform ranks and at each domain's own best rank. Giving experts different ranks costs averaging and utility-based selection nothing, and gains them up to 1.8 pp of multi-domain accuracy, while the conflict-resolution methods are inconsistent and can lose up to 4 pp. The split has a simple cause. Merging keeps only a fixed share of the pooled spectral components, and methods that choose them by size discard many that would have reduced loss. They also tend to discard the same expert: the instruction adapter has the smallest singular values, so it is dropped almost entirely and IFEval falls by 16 to 25 pp. Choosing components by their effect on loss instead keeps all three experts, and leaves accuracy nearly flat across an 8$\times$ rank range (0.7 pp, against 6.7 pp for TIES at 4B scale). Rank can therefore be chosen per expert whenever the merge operator does not select by magnitude.
papers.translated_summary: 模型合并将分别微调的专家整合为单一模型而无需重新训练。标准做法是以相同的LoRA秩训练每个专家，这即使每个领域各有其最佳秩，也将秩的选择跨专家耦合在一起。我们表明这种耦合是合并方法的属性，而非合并本身的属性。我们在三个领域（数学、指令遵循、多语言）以四个秩和三种模型规模训练了36个专家，然后以统一秩和每个领域各自的最佳秩用六种方法进行合并。给专家不同的秩对平均法和基于效用的选择法毫无损失，并使其多领域准确率提升最多1.8个百分点，而冲突解决方法则表现不一致，可能损失最多4个百分点。这种分化有一个简单的原因。合并只保留池化谱成分的固定份额，而按大小选择这些成分的方法会丢弃许多本可降低损失的成分。它们还倾向于丢弃同一个专家：指令适配器具有最小的奇异值，因此几乎被完全丢弃，IFEval下降16至25个百分点。相反，按成分对损失的影响来选择成分会保留所有三个专家，并使准确率在8倍秩范围内几乎持平（0.7个百分点，而TIES在4B规模下为6.7个百分点）。因此，只要合并算子不按幅度进行选择，秩就可以按专家分别选择。

papers.title: Object-independent evaluation of small-data astronomical image classifiers: architecture, representation, and acquisition shortcuts
papers.translated_title: 小数据天文图像分类器的对象无关评估：架构、表示与采集捷径
papers.author: Eraldo Pereira Marinho
papers.summary: Reported performance in small astronomical image datasets can reflect object reuse, field-of-view differences, acquisition settings, and catalogue-derived properties as well as astronomical morphology. We designed \dataset{} to measure these effects in a four-class task comprising galaxies, globular clusters, nebulae, and open clusters. The dataset contains 370 catalogue-supported physical objects, each represented by three Digitised Sky Survey FITS bands, and uses a group-constrained split of 222 training, 75 validation, and 73 test objects. We compared a custom CNN--Transformer trained from scratch with ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-50 and ViT-B/16 under an adaptive full-field representation, a common angular field, and two central-region-masked controls, using three fixed seeds. In the one-pass object-independent test, mean balanced accuracy on the adaptive view was $0.773\pm0.014$, $0.874\pm0.054$, and $0.866\pm0.023$ for the custom model, ResNet-50, and ViT-B/16, respectively. No primary architecture contrast rejected its null after Holm correction; ResNet-50 and ViT-B/16 differed by 0.007 balanced-accuracy points (95\% cluster-bootstrap interval $[-0.048,0.062]$). Controls based on acquisition and catalogue metadata reached 0.721--0.735, and central-region-masked adaptive views reached 0.731--0.800. These results demonstrate generalisation to unseen physical objects, but also show that image context, acquisition settings, and catalogue-derived object properties carry substantial class information. In this regime, high accuracy cannot be interpreted as evidence that a classifier learned target morphology, and the comparison does not isolate architecture from pretraining.
papers.translated_summary: 在小天文图像数据集上报告的的性能可能反映对象复用、视场差异、采集设置和目录衍生属性，以及天文形态。我们设计了\dataset{}来测量这些效应，任务为四分类，包括星系、球状星团、星云和疏散星团。该数据集包含370个目录支持的物理对象，每个对象由三个数字化巡天FITS波段表示，并采用组约束划分：222个训练对象、75个验证对象和73个测试对象。我们在自适应全视场表示、共同角视场和两个中心区域掩蔽对照下，使用三个固定种子，将从零开始训练的自定义CNN--Transformer与ImageNet预训练的ResNet-50和ViT-B/16进行比较。在单次对象独立测试中，自适应视图上的平均平衡准确率对于自定义模型、ResNet-50和ViT-B/16分别为$0.773\pm0.014$、$0.874\pm0.054$和$0.866\pm0.023$。经Holm校正后，没有主要架构对比拒绝其原假设；ResNet-50和ViT-B/16相差0.007个平衡准确率点（95\%聚类自助区间$[-0.048,0.062]$）。基于采集和目录元数据的对照达到0.721--0.735，中心区域掩蔽的自适应视图达到0.731--0.800。这些结果证明了对未见物理对象的泛化能力，但也表明图像上下文、采集设置和目录衍生的对象属性携带了大量类别信息。在这种情况下，高准确率不能解释为分类器学习了目标形态的证据，且该比较未将架构与预训练隔离开来。

papers.title: What Does Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning Really Improve in LLM Agents?
papers.translated_title: 多轮强化学习在LLM智能体中究竟真正改进了什么？
papers.author: Kejian Zhu
papers.summary: While multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning (RL) excels on long-horizon tasks, its performance gains remain highly sensitive to interaction constraints. Evaluating across sampling breadth $K$ and interaction depth $T$ via $Pass@(K,T)$, we show that trajectory-level RL advantages depend on sufficient turn budgets, diminishing significantly when budgets tighten. Besides, agentic RL does not uniformly elevate single-step decision quality; rather, its strength concentrates in error recovery and long-horizon resilience. To mitigate the deployment risks caused by this budget dependence, we provide a preliminary discussion on the benefits and limitations of process supervision signals and introduce BudgetMix RL as an alternative that varies interaction budgets during training. Experiments demonstrate that BudgetMix RL achieves robust performance across diverse execution settings. Project Page: https://rethinking-agentic-rl.github.io/
papers.translated_summary: 多轮智能体强化学习（RL）在长时程任务上表现优异，但其性能增益对交互约束高度敏感。我们通过 Pass@(K,T) 在采样广度 K 和交互深度 T 上进行评估，结果表明轨迹级 RL 优势依赖于充足的轮次预算，当预算收紧时显著衰减。此外，智能体 RL 并非一致地提升单步决策质量，其优势集中于错误恢复与长时程韧性。为缓解这种预算依赖性带来的部署风险，我们对过程监督信号的收益与局限进行了初步讨论，并引入 BudgetMix RL 作为替代方案，在训练过程中变化交互预算。实验表明，BudgetMix RL 在多样化的执行设置下均能取得稳健性能。项目页面：https://rethinking-agentic-rl.github.io/

papers.title: ArcRAG: Agentic Compositional Retrieval over Knowledge Graphs
papers.translated_title: ArcRAG：知识图谱上的智能体组合检索
papers.author: Jyotin Goel
papers.summary: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) answers questions by retrieving over a knowledge graph built from a corpus. Yet retrieval strategies are designed around the structure their own construction pipeline produces, and whether they survive a change of construction is rarely tested. We study this cross-construction portability: whether one retrieval procedure, with no construction-specific schema, relation names, or retuning, stays effective when the graph is built differently. We introduce ArcRAG, which induces a query-local graph interface at inference time (the node labels, relation descriptors, and property keys reachable from the entities a question names), plans multi-hop traversals against it, and executes and repairs them as Cypher. We build each of the MuSiQue, HotpotQA, and TriviaQA corpora as a schema-guided graph (typed nodes, a closed relation set, source provenance) and as an open-information-extraction graph (untyped nodes, free-text relations), with the retriever's configuration fixed across them. We compare against a construction-agnostic Direct-Cypher agent, ablate each stage across retry and pass budgets on both graph families, and compare with results reported for prior GraphRAG systems, most of which design retrieval together with their own graph construction. Across the two constructions, we find that retrieval need not be co-designed with the graph: query-time interface induction keeps a construction-agnostic retriever effective when the construction changes, although construction still shapes absolute accuracy.
papers.translated_summary: 基于图的检索增强生成（GraphRAG）通过在一个由语料库构建的知识图谱上进行检索来回答问题。然而，检索策略是围绕其自身构建流程所产生的结构来设计的，而这些策略能否在构建方式改变后依然有效，却鲜有测试。我们研究这种跨构建的可移植性：即一种检索流程，在不依赖特定构建模式的模式、关系名称或重新调参的情况下，当图以不同方式构建时，是否仍能保持有效。我们提出 ArcRAG，它在推理时归纳出一个查询局部的图接口（即从问题所提及实体可达的节点标签、关系描述符和属性键），针对该接口规划多跳遍历，并以 Cypher 形式执行和修复这些遍历。我们将 MuSiQue、HotpotQA 和 TriviaQA 各语料库分别构建为模式引导图（带类型节点、封闭关系集、来源溯源）和开放信息抽取图（无类型节点、自由文本关系），且检索器的配置在两者之间保持固定。我们与一个构建无关的 Direct-Cypher 智能体进行比较，在两种图族上分别针对重试和通过预算对每个阶段进行消融，并与先前 GraphRAG 系统所报告的结果进行比较，这些系统大多将检索与自身的图构建一同设计。在两种构建方式下，我们发现检索无需与图协同设计：查询时接口归纳使得构建无关的检索器在构建方式改变时仍保持有效，尽管构建方式仍然影响绝对准确率。

papers.title: Towards Early Warning of Real-World Vulnerabilities: An Evidence-Aware Decoupled Method for CVSS Vector Prediction Based on Unstructured Disclosures
papers.translated_title: 面向现实世界漏洞的早期预警：一种基于非结构化披露的、证据感知的解耦式CVSS向量预测方法
papers.author: Jianhong Ma
papers.summary: Early assessment of Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) vectors from Open Source Intelligence (OSINT) can reduce the delay between initial public disclosure and official National Vulnerability Database (NVD) scoring. Existing predictors, trained mainly on standardized late-stage descriptions, degrade on noisy and incomplete pre-NVD reports. We introduce PARSE, a vulnerability-disclosure lifecycle model, and VPre, an early assessment framework built on two-level Evidence-Aware Decoupling. Decoupling Level I, Security-Evidence Screening, separates security-relevant evidence from noisy early reports at the report and sentence levels. Decoupling Level II, Evidence-Matched Routing, decouples the prediction task of the eight CVSS metrics into a scattered-evidence class and an explicit-evidence class based on validation-set measurements, matching each with a targeted predictor: large-language-model reasoning for the former, lightweight supervised classification for the latter. On the 851-report held-out test split of the 5,581-report VPre-Bench, VPre achieves a mean absolute error of 0.7239 -- 44.7% below the reproduced BERT-Small-NVD early-transfer baseline; paired timestamps across the full benchmark show an average 38-day lead before official scoring (observed range 21-60 days). Under the 38:1 PARSE-Triage noise setting, STDU's report-level screening reaches 0.98 precision, 1.00 recall, and 0.99 F1. Controlled ablations support the contributions of both decoupling levels.
papers.translated_summary: 对来自开源情报（OSINT）的通用漏洞评分系统（CVSS）向量的早期评估，可以缩短初始公开披露与官方国家漏洞数据库（NVD）评分之间的延迟。现有预测器主要基于标准化的后期描述进行训练，在嘈杂且不完整的NVD前报告上性能下降。我们引入PARSE，一个漏洞披露生命周期模型，以及VPre，一个基于两级证据感知解耦的早期评估框架。解耦第一级，安全证据筛选，在报告和句子两个层面将安全相关证据与嘈杂的早期报告分离。解耦第二级，证据匹配路由，基于验证集测量将八个CVSS指标的预测任务解耦为分散证据类和显式证据类，并为每一类匹配针对性的预测器：前者采用大语言模型推理，后者采用轻量级监督分类。在5,581份报告的VPre-Bench的851份报告留出测试划分上，VPre实现了0.7239的平均绝对误差——比复现的BERT-Small-NVD早期迁移基线低44.7%；整个基准上的配对时间戳显示，在官方评分前平均领先38天（观测范围为21-60天）。在38:1的PARSE-Triage噪声设置下，STDU的报告级筛选达到0.98精确率、1.00召回率和0.99 F1。受控消融实验支持两个解耦级别的贡献。

papers.title: The Alignment Tax Is Graded: Task-Selective Capability Loss Under Length-Normalized DPO with SFT Retention
papers.translated_title: 对齐税是有等级的：在长度归一化DPO与SFT保留下的任务选择性能力损失
papers.author: Ye Yuan
papers.summary: Setting. This is an empirical characterization study; we propose no new method and run no comparisons against alternative objectives. We fine-tune Qwen3.5-4B with sparse LoRA and length-normalized DPO plus an SFT retention term (the RPO objective) on structured financial-filing tasks, and track downstream capability as the implicit reward margin grows to $\sim 7$ $β$-scaled units (nf4 training; $\sim 3$ under fp16 measurement on the unquantized base). Question. Does margin growth degrade capability uniformly across tasks, or selectively? Findings. In a pre-registered study (8 seeds, 6 unseen at freeze) with artifact-aware scoring and TOST equivalence testing, the alignment tax is graded and task-selective: extraction is preserved ($Δ= -0.55$ pts, equivalent at $\pm5$ pts), json loses little ($Δ= -3.52$ pts, equivalence fails on a clustered item-level interval), and router degrades severely ($Δ= -30$ pts). Router's loss concentrates in a margin 1-3 damage window containing a transient format-break spike. The margin is accounted for almost entirely ($\geq 96\%$) by suppression of rejected completions, with chosen reward approximately flat, consistent with the retention term anchoring it; we do not attribute the behavioral damage to any single gradient channel. Gold-logp deflation is task-selective (extraction $-0.15$, json $-1.04$, router $-1.47$ nats/token under fp16), with gold selectively protected relative to incorrect controls on extraction (8/8 seeds). QLoRA reward margins differ up to $3.4\times$ between nf4 training and unquantized fp16 measurement, with an axis-dependent gap. Scope. Length-normalized rewards with SFT retention, sparse LoRA on 8/32 layers, one 4B model, easily-separable synthetic preferences, three structured tasks. A no-retention control and a measured format-alignment metric are left to future work.
papers.translated_summary: 背景。这是一项实证性刻画研究；我们不提出新方法，也不与替代目标进行对比。我们在结构化财务申报任务上，使用稀疏 LoRA 和长度归一化 DPO 加 SFT 保持项（即 RPO 目标）微调 Qwen3.5-4B，并随着隐式奖励间隔增长至约 7 个 β 缩放单位（nf4 训练；在未量化基座的 fp16 测量下约为 3）跟踪下游能力。问题。间隔增长是均匀地降低各任务能力，还是选择性地降低？发现。在一项预注册研究（8 个种子，冻结时 6 个未见）中，采用工件感知评分和 TOST 等价性检验，对齐税是分级的且具有任务选择性：抽取能力得以保持（Δ= -0.55 分，在 ±5 分处等价），json 损失较小（Δ= -3.52 分，在聚类项目级区间上等价性不成立），router 严重退化（Δ= -30 分）。router 的损失集中在包含瞬态格式中断尖峰的间隔 1-3 损害窗口内。该间隔几乎完全（≥ 96%）由对被拒绝补全的抑制所解释，被选中奖励大致持平，这与保持项对其锚定一致；我们不将行为损害归因于任何单一梯度通道。Gold-logp 通缩具有任务选择性（在 fp16 下，抽取 -0.15、json -1.04、router -1.47 nats/token），并且在抽取任务上，gold 相对于错误对照被选择性保护（8/8 种子）。QLoRA 奖励间隔在 nf4 训练与未量化 fp16 测量之间相差最多 3.4 倍，且存在轴依赖的差距。范围。带 SFT 保持的长度归一化奖励、8/32 层上的稀疏 LoRA、一个 4B 模型、易于分离的合成偏好、三个结构化任务。无保持对照和已测量的格式对齐指标留待未来工作。

papers.title: A 3D foundation model unifying CT interpretation and segmentation
papers.translated_title: 一个统一CT解读与分割的三维基础模型
papers.author: Yulu Xie
papers.summary: Radiologists interpret computed tomography (CT) scans by jointly determining what a finding represents and where it lies in three-dimensional (3D) anatomy. However, CT models have treated CT interpretation and 3D segmentation as separate tasks, leaving textual findings spatially unverifiable and overlooking potential synergy between clinical understanding and spatial perception. Here we present HoloCT, a generalist 3D foundation model unifying CT interpretation and voxel-level segmentation by jointly modelling whole-volume context and fine-grained anatomical detail, providing 3D masks as evidence. We curated HoloDATA, comprising 195,921 CT scans from 73 public datasets and six clinical cohorts, with 6.2 million instruction dialogues and 2.8 million CT-mask pairs. Across 346 tasks spanning segmentation, lesion screening, visual question answering, and report generation on 61 internal and 12 external datasets, HoloCT outperformed specialist and foundation models. In multicentre validation across 11,455 clinical CT scans from five hospitals, HoloCT outperformed competing models in lesion segmentation and report generation by 18.2 and 15.3 points. It also achieved 85.1% mean accuracy in screening thyroid tumours and colon lesions, exceeding all four participating radiologists in a retrospective reader study. Further analyses revealed bidirectional semantic-spatial synergy: language-guided segmentation delineated unseen anatomical structures and lesions as well as diffuse free-text findings, outperforming the leading approach by 22.1 points, whereas prompting the model to generate corresponding 3D masks alongside its textual outputs significantly improved interpretation performance. HoloCT shows that clinical understanding and spatial perception can be learned together within a single foundation model and offers a path towards more accurate and reliable CT analysis.
papers.translated_summary: 放射科医生解读计算机断层扫描（CT）时，需要同时判断某个征象代表什么以及它位于三维（3D）解剖结构中的何处。然而，CT模型一直将CT解读与3D分割视为彼此独立的任务，导致文本征象在空间上无法验证，也忽视了临床理解与空间感知之间潜在的协同作用。在此，我们提出HoloCT，这是一个通用的3D基础模型，通过联合建模全容积上下文和细粒度解剖细节，将CT解读与体素级分割统一起来，并提供3D掩码作为证据。我们构建了HoloDATA，包含来自73个公开数据集和六个临床队列的195，921例CT扫描，以及620万条指令对话和280万对CT-掩码配对。在涵盖分割、病灶筛查、视觉问答和报告生成等346项任务（涉及61个内部数据集和12个外部数据集）上，HoloCT优于专科模型和基础模型。在来自五家医院的11，455例临床CT扫描的多中心验证中，HoloCT在病灶分割和报告生成方面分别以18.2分和15.3分优于竞争模型。在筛查甲状腺肿瘤和结肠病灶方面，其平均准确率达到85.1%，在一项回顾性阅片者研究中超过了全部四位参与的放射科医生。进一步分析揭示了双向的语义-空间协同：语言引导的分割能够描绘未见过的解剖结构和病灶以及弥漫性自由文本征象，以22.1分优于领先方法；而提示模型在输出文本的同时生成相应的3D掩码，则显著提升了判读性能。HoloCT表明，临床理解与空间感知可以在单一基础模型内共同学习，并为更准确、更可靠的CT分析提供了一条路径。

papers.title: How many sorted projections determine n points in k dimensions?
papers.translated_title: 在k维空间中，有多少个排序投影能确定n个点？
papers.author: Christopher Gorham Lester
papers.summary: Let $d_1,\dots,d_m$ be directions in $\mathbb{R}^k$, where $k\ge 2$. A multiset $X$ of $n$ points of $\mathbb{R}^k$ projects to the $m$ multisets of numbers $\{\{x\cdot d_j : x\in X\}\}$, or equivalently to the $m$ sorted lists of these numbers. How many directions are needed for these projections to determine every multiset of $n$ points? Two simple bounds are known in every dimension: more than $(k-1)\log_2 n$ directions are always needed, and $(k-1)n+1$ directions in general position always suffice. In the plane much more is known: Matousek, Privetivy and Skovron showed that almost every choice of $O(\log n \log\log n)$ directions suffices. Whether anything similar holds in higher dimensions was left open by Dym, Wellershoff, Tsoukanis, Levy and Balan. We observe that two lemmas of Hair and Sahai, proved for list recovery of random linear codes, answer that question, and by tightening their argument we show that in every dimension almost every choice of $(4k-2)\ln(2n)\ln(k\log_2 2n)+k+1$ directions suffices. For $k\le 10$ this beats the linear bound once $n$ is larger than about 100: for example, 144 directions suffice for multisets of 1000 points in the plane, and an exact computation lowers this to 133. Letting some of the random blocks in their argument fail removes a factor $\log k$: almost every choice of $O(k\log n\log\log n)$ directions suffices, uniformly in $k$ and $n$. We also show that $2k-1$ directions never determine three points, so that the logarithmic lower bound is not tight; that every $m$ directions in the plane fail on some pair of multisets of size $O(1.78^m)$, improving the bound $O(1.80^m)$ of Matousek, Privetivy and Skovron; and that for each $k$, $m$ and $n$, either almost every choice of $m$ directions works or almost none does.
papers.translated_summary: 设 $d_1,\dots,d_m$ 为 $\mathbb{R}^k$ 中的方向，其中 $k\ge 2$。一个由 $\mathbb{R}^k$ 中 $n$ 个点构成的多重集 $X$ 投影为 $m$ 个数值多重集 $\{\{x\cdot d_j : x\in X\}\}$，或等价地投影为这些数的 $m$ 个排序列表。要使这些投影确定每一个 $n$ 点的多重集，需要多少个方向？在每个维度上已知两个简单的界：总是需要多于 $(k-1)\log_2 n$ 个方向，而处于一般位置的 $(k-1)n+1$ 个方向总是足够的。在平面中已知的结果要多得多：Matousek、Privetivy 和 Skovron 证明了几乎每一组 $O(\log n \log\log n)$ 个方向的选择都足够。更高维中是否有类似的结果，被 Dym、Wellershoff、Tsoukanis、Levy 和 Balan 留作未解决的问题。我们注意到，Hair 和 Sahai 为随机线性码的列表恢复所证明的两个引理回答了这个问题，并且通过收紧他们的论证，我们证明在每个维度上，几乎每一组 $(4k-2)\ln(2n)\ln(k\log_2 2n)+k+1$ 个方向的选择都足够。对于 $k\le 10$，一旦 $n$ 大于约 100，这就胜过了线性界：例如，对于平面中 1000 个点的多重集，144 个方向就足够，而精确计算将此降低到 133。让他们论证中的一些随机块失败，可以去掉一个因子 $\log k$：几乎每一组 $O(k\log n\log\log n)$ 个方向的选择都足够，且关于 $k$ 和 $n$ 一致。我们还证明 $2k-1$ 个方向永远不能确定三个点，因此对数下界并不紧；平面中每 $m$ 个方向都会在某对大小为 $O(1.78^m)$ 的多重集上失败，改进了 Matousek、Privetivy 和 Skovron 的界 $O(1.80^m)$；并且对于每个 $k$、$m$ 和 $n$，要么几乎每一组 $m$ 个方向的选择都有效，要么几乎没有一个有效。

papers.title: Auditing Biomedical Literature with Blinded AI Peer Review: Where Peer Review Works, Where It Fails, and How to Strengthen It
papers.translated_title: 以盲法人工智能同行评审审计生物医学文献：同行评审在何处有效、在何处失效，以及如何加强它
papers.author: Kosakovsky Pond, S. L.
papers.summary: Biomedical publishing has grown more than elevenfold since 1991, outstripping human peer review. Unblinded language models cannot audit this literature objectively because they recognize famous authors and journals from training memory. We built BARS (Blinded AI Review System), an automated referee that strips titles, author names, institutions, journal headers, and dates before grading full-text manuscripts on a 10-point scale covering methods, evidence, biology, and reproducibility. We used BARS to generate 1,874 blind reviews across 1,714 unique papers. BARS passed 100% of verified sound controls, caught 77% to 91% of internally flawed papers, eliminated a +0.35-point prestige boost, and more than doubled human referee consistency. Across 320 recent open-access articles (2020-2025) from eight fields, 54% failed on core scientific rigor (<5.0/10; 41% excluding megajournals). Revision at selective journals improved preprints more than twice as much as revision at commercial megajournals (+0.62 vs. +0.30 points; baseline-adjusted p = 0.033), and BARS recalled 98% of unresolved human referee critiques across 100 open-review papers. Across 915 date-blinded papers from 1991 to 2025, average scores fell from 7.6/10 to 5.8/10 as megajournals and template database studies expanded. Blinded self-audits of 238 papers by two senior authors -- and of this manuscript itself -- caught real statistical, control, and table errors in our own work. At four cents per paper, BARS offers a practical quality check for authors, journals, and readers (https://veg.github.io/BARS/).
papers.translated_summary: 自1991年以来，生物医学出版量增长了十一倍以上，已超出人类同行评审的承载能力。非盲语言模型无法客观审查这些文献，因为它们能从训练记忆中识别出著名作者和期刊。我们构建了BARS（盲审人工智能评审系统），这是一个自动化审稿工具，在按10分制对全文稿件进行评分之前，会剥离标题、作者姓名、机构、期刊页眉和日期，评分涵盖方法、证据、生物学和可重复性。我们使用BARS对1,714篇独特论文生成了1,874份盲审意见。BARS通过了100%的经验证可靠对照，捕获了77%至91%的存在内部缺陷的论文，消除了+0.35分的声望加成，并使人类审稿人的一致性提高了一倍以上。在来自八个领域的320篇近期开放获取文章（2020-2025年）中，54%在核心科学严谨性上不合格（<5.0/10；排除巨型期刊后为41%）。选择性期刊的修订对预印本的改善程度是商业巨型期刊修订的两倍以上（+0.62对+0.30分；基线调整后p = 0.033），并且BARS在100篇开放评审论文中召回了98%的未解决人类审稿人批评意见。在1991年至2025年的915篇日期盲审论文中，随着巨型期刊和模板数据库研究的扩张，平均得分从7.6/10降至5.8/10。两位资深作者对238篇论文进行的盲审自审——以及对本稿件本身的自审——在我们自己的工作中发现了真实的统计、对照和表格错误。每篇论文四美分的成本下，BARS为作者、期刊和读者提供了一种实用的质量检查工具（https://veg.github.io/BARS/）。

papers.title: Conserved synaptic modifications by humanized tau through diverse isoform- and mutation-specific intracellular interactions
papers.translated_title: 人源化tau通过多种异构体和突变特异性的细胞内相互作用保守的突触修饰
papers.author: Nickerson, E.
papers.summary: Mutations in the microtubule-binding protein tau are considered causal for a diverse group of neurodegenerative diseases collectively referred to as primary tauopathies. Specific tauopathies are associated with different mutations, distinct tau isoforms, manifest in unique cellular and circuit-wide patterns of degeneration, and present with specific clinical symptoms and trajectories. The mechanisms that link variations in the primary tau protein structure to distinct forms of neural circuit dysfunction remain largely unknown. Here, we created an orthogonal viral resource to systematically examine the impact of expressing humanized tau isoforms harboring different disease-relevant mutations in excitatory pyramidal cells from the mouse prelimbic cortex. We used these reagents to show that expression of mutant humanized tau (hTau) as either of two isoforms produced very similar patterns of circuit-specific synaptic disconnection on cortical projection neurons. However, mass spectrometry revealed that the interactomes of these different tau species varied markedly as functions of isoform, mutation, and subcellular location. We validated the functional relevance of increased hTau interactions with mitochondrial proteins in induced neurons differentiated from Ngn2-iPSCs expressing different hTau constructs. These results suggest different disease-relevant hTau proteins likely use distinct mechanisms to drive a highly stereotyped form of synapse loss in cortical neurons.
papers.translated_summary: 微管结合蛋白tau的突变被认为是导致一组统称为原发性tau蛋白病的多种神经退行性疾病的病因。特定的tau蛋白病与不同的突变、不同的tau异构体相关，表现为独特的细胞和环路层面的退化模式，并呈现出特定的临床症状和病程轨迹。将初级tau蛋白结构变异与不同形式的神经环路功能障碍联系起来的机制在很大程度上仍不清楚。在此，我们构建了一种正交病毒资源，以系统性地检测在小鼠前边缘皮层兴奋性锥体细胞中表达携带不同疾病相关突变的人源化tau异构体的影响。我们利用这些试剂证明，表达突变型人源化tau（hTau）的两种异构体中的任何一种，均可在皮层投射神经元上产生非常相似的环路特异性突触断开模式。然而，质谱分析揭示，这些不同tau物种的相互作用组因异构体、突变和亚细胞定位的不同而存在显著差异。我们在由表达不同hTau构建体的Ngn2-iPSCs分化而来的诱导神经元中，验证了hTau与线粒体蛋白相互作用增加的功能相关性。这些结果表明，不同的疾病相关hTau蛋白可能利用不同的机制来驱动皮层神经元中一种高度刻板化的突触丢失形式。

papers.title: Serial dependence carries the action that produced the previous report
papers.translated_title: 序列依赖性承载了产生前一报告的动作
papers.author: Qu, C.
papers.summary: Serial dependence pulls current judgments toward the recent past, but what is carried forward is debated: the previous stimulus, the previous decision, or something about the report itself. Three magnitude-reproduction experiments separated these sources. Participants viewed dot arrays that varied independently in duration and numerosity, then reproduced the cued dimension by holding a key while a display accumulated, so that both magnitudes were produced through the same action. A response-history model partitioned the attraction into previous-stimulus and previous-response paths. The previous response predicted cross-dimensional attraction after controlling for the previous and current stimuli: a numerosity report biased the next duration judgment and vice versa (Experiment 1), also when each task used its own response key (Experiment 2). A task switch weakened this carryover without abolishing it. Experiment 3 randomized, trial by trial, whether a reported number required a long or a short key hold. The influence of a previous number on the next duration judgment changed with this mapping, showing that reported value alone did not account for carryover. Conventional stimulus-based measures showed none of this cross-task history. Serial dependence can therefore carry the trace of the action through which a previous judgment was expressed, bounded but not gated by task context.
papers.translated_summary: 序列依赖会将当前判断拉向近期过去，但被延续下来的是什么仍有争议：是先前的刺激、先前的决定，还是与报告本身有关的某些内容。三项量级再现实验分离了这些来源。参与者观看在时距和数量上独立变化的点阵，然后通过按住按键同时让显示累积来再现被提示的维度，因此两种量级都通过同一动作产生。一个反应历史模型将吸引效应分解为先前刺激路径和先前反应路径。在控制先前和当前刺激后，先前反应预测了跨维度吸引：数量报告会偏向随后的时距判断，反之亦然（实验1），当每个任务使用各自的反应键时也是如此（实验2）。任务切换削弱了这种延续效应，但未将其消除。实验3逐试次随机化所报告数字需要长按键还是短按键。先前数字对随后时距判断的影响随这一映射而变化，表明仅报告值本身不能解释延续效应。传统的基于刺激的测量未显示出这种跨任务历史。因此，序列依赖可以携带先前判断借以表达的动作痕迹，受任务情境约束但不受其门控。

papers.title: Mitochondria-Coupled Hitchhiking Drives Vimentin Intermediate Filament Transport
papers.translated_title: 线粒体偶联的搭便车驱动波形蛋白中间丝运输
papers.author: Renganathan, B.
papers.summary: Vimentin intermediate filaments (VIFs) undergo active microtubule-dependent transport throughout the cell, with trajectories resembling those of motor-driven organelles, yet our recent work showed that only a small subset of VIFs lies close to microtubules. How VIFs engage the microtubule-based transport machinery, and whether additional transport routes contribute, remain unresolved. We hypothesized that VIFs move indirectly, by hitchhiking on motile organelles, and tested this using mitochondria. Live imaging showed mitochondria and adjacent VIFs moving together, and volume electron microscopy revealed VIFs closely following mitochondrial surfaces at sites distinct from microtubule contacts. Depleting the mitochondrial motor adaptor TRAK1 to inhibit anterograde mitochondrial transport shifted both mitochondria and VIFs toward the nucleus. Driving mitochondria toward the cell periphery with a tailless kinesin-1 in cells lacking endogenous kinesin-1, or toward the cell center with a minus-end-directed motor, redistributed a subset of VIFs in the same direction. Thus, VIF transport to a large extend is accomplished by hitchhiking on motile mitochondria.
papers.translated_summary: 波形蛋白中间丝（VIFs）在整个细胞中经历活跃的微管依赖性运输，其运动轨迹类似于马达驱动的细胞器，但我们最近的研究表明，只有一小部分VIFs靠近微管。VIFs如何参与基于微管的运输机制，以及是否有其他运输途径参与其中，仍未得到解决。我们假设VIFs通过搭便车在运动细胞器上间接移动，并利用线粒体对此进行了验证。活细胞成像显示线粒体与相邻的VIFs一起移动，体积电子显微镜显示VIFs在不同于微管接触位点的位置紧密跟随线粒体表面。敲低线粒体马达衔接蛋白TRAK1以抑制顺行线粒体运输，使线粒体和VIFs均向细胞核方向移动。在缺乏内源性驱动蛋白-1的细胞中，用无尾部驱动蛋白-1将线粒体驱向细胞外周，或用向微管负极方向运动的马达将线粒体驱向细胞中心，可使一部分VIFs向相同方向重新分布。因此，VIFs的运输在很大程度上是通过搭便车在运动线粒体上完成的。

papers.title: Sex-specific bone marrow populations regulate skeletal phenotype and identify CD74-marked osteoclast precursor subsets
papers.translated_title: 性别特异性骨髓细胞群体调控骨骼表型并鉴定CD74标记的破骨细胞前体亚群
papers.author: Koroth, J.
papers.summary: While there are clear differences in bone accrual and maintenance between men and women due to hormonal regulation, the potential cell-intrinsic factors governing this difference are poorly understood. To investigate this, we performed bone marrow transplantation assays using male or female bone marrow transplantation into male hosts. Micro-CT analyses of lethally irradiated 8-week-old male mice transplanted with female bone marrow exhibited increased vertebral body trabecular and cortical bone mass. To identify cell types mediating these effects, we performed comparative single cell sequencing analyses and identified several CD11B+CD74+ myeloid cell clusters. Male donor BM chimeric mice had a higher proportion of Cd74-expressing clusters compared to female donor BM chimeric mice. We confirmed that males have greater numbers of bone marrow-resident CD11B+CD74+ cells under physiological conditions. Elevated expression of X-linked genes Tlr7 and Kdm6a marked a population of CD11B+CD74+ cells. Lastly, we show that female CD11B+CD74+ cells exhibit diminished osteoclastogenesis. These findings demonstrate that male and female bone marrow-resident cells have cell-intrinsic differences that regulate bone mass and that CD74 marks a subset of osteoclast precursor-enriched myeloid populations.
papers.translated_summary: 尽管由于激素调节，男性和女性在骨量获得和维持方面存在明显差异，但调控这种差异的潜在细胞内在因素仍知之甚少。为了研究这一问题，我们进行了骨髓移植实验，将雄性或不性骨髓移植到雄性宿主中。对接受致死剂量照射的8周龄雄性小鼠移植雌性骨髓后进行Micro-CT分析，显示椎体小梁骨和皮质骨量增加。为了确定介导这些效应的细胞类型，我们进行了比较单细胞测序分析，并鉴定出若干CD11B+CD74+髓系细胞簇。雄性供体骨髓嵌合小鼠相比雌性供体骨髓嵌合小鼠具有更高比例的表达Cd74的细胞簇。我们证实，在生理条件下雄性具有更多数量的骨髓驻留CD11B+CD74+细胞。X连锁基因Tlr7和Kdm6a的表达升高标记了一群CD11B+CD74+细胞。最后，我们证明雌性CD11B+CD74+细胞的破骨细胞生成能力减弱。这些发现表明，雄性和雌性骨髓驻留细胞具有调控骨量的细胞内在差异，且CD74标记了一个富含破骨细胞前体的髓系细胞亚群。

papers.title: PPI-Rescue: restoration of eye development via functional reconstitution of a transcription complex.
papers.translated_title: PPI-Rescue：通过转录复合物的功能性重建恢复眼睛发育。
papers.author: Jusic, N.
papers.summary: The activity of transcription factors (TFs) can be modulated through protein-protein interactions (PPIs) with cofactors which can serve to enhance, repress or alter the specificity of TF function. Current genetic and molecular approaches such as knockout and overexpression studies are likely to affect all possible activities of a TF, presenting a dilemma when attempting to parse out how TFs function within a cell. Hence, there is a need to devise a technique that will allow for mechanistic insight to be gained into the function(s) of discrete transcription complexes. Herein we report ''PPI-Rescue'', an approach that leverages bespoke mutations in TFs and the selective reconstitution of specific complexes to study the molecular properties and biological functions of discrete transcription complexes in vitro and in vivo. We demonstrate PPI-Rescue using the conserved Drosophila transcription factor Sine oculis (So) and cofactor Eyes Absent (Eya). To validate this approach, we engineered a missense mutation, So{Delta}Eya (C110S), that selectively abrogates PPI-Eya to show that PPI-Eya is necessary for the transcriptional activity of So in cultured cells and to promote eye formation in Drosophila. Using heterologous leucine zipper domains, we specifically reconstituted the So{Delta}Eya-Eya PPI and show that this complex is transcriptionally active in cells and can rescue eye development. PPI-Rescue was also used to restore transcriptional activity to So{Delta}PPI (V111E), an allele that mimics the human SIX1(V17E) allele associated with Branchio-Oto-Renal syndrome. PPI-Rescue thus represents an innovative approach to understanding the complex molecular logic of transcription complexes in both development and disease.
papers.translated_summary: 转录因子（TFs）的活性可以通过与辅因子的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPIs）进行调节，这些辅因子能够增强、抑制或改变TF功能的特异性。当前的遗传学和分子学方法，如敲除和过表达研究，可能会影响TF所有可能的活动，这在试图解析TF在细胞中如何发挥功能时造成了困境。因此，需要设计一种技术，能够获得对离散转录复合物功能的机制性洞察。在此我们报道了“PPI-Rescue”，一种利用TF中的定制突变和特定复合物的选择性重建来研究离散转录复合物在体外和体内的分子特性和生物学功能的方法。我们使用保守的果蝇转录因子Sine oculis（So）和辅因子Eyes Absent（Eya）来展示PPI-Rescue。为验证该方法，我们设计了一个错义突变So{Delta}Eya（C110S），选择性消除PPI-Eya，以证明PPI-Eya对于So在培养细胞中的转录活性以及促进果蝇眼部形成是必需的。利用异源亮氨酸拉链结构域，我们特异性地重建了So{Delta}Eya-Eya PPI，并证明该复合物在细胞中具有转录活性，且能够挽救眼部发育。PPI-Rescue还被用于恢复So{Delta}PPI（V111E）的转录活性，该等位基因模拟了与Branchio-Oto-Renal综合征相关的人类SIX1(V17E)等位基因。因此，PPI-Rescue代表了一种创新方法，可用于理解发育和疾病中转录复合物的复杂分子逻辑。

papers.title: Habitat degradation destabilizes complex metacommunities by disrupting dispersal
papers.translated_title: 生境退化通过破坏扩散过程使复杂的集合群落失稳
papers.author: Sun, Y.
papers.summary: Habitat loss and fragmentation are rapidly reshaping ecosystems worldwide, yet their consequences for ecological stability remain unresolved. Classical theory, pioneered by Robert May, established rigorous criteria for stability; however, these apply to spatially well-mixed communities, limiting their relevance to habitat degradation. Here, we develop a metacommunity framework that integrates classical stability theory with spatial dynamics to determine how anthropogenic habitat degradation reshapes ecosystem stability. We show that metacommunities exhibit three distinct dynamical regimes following a perturbation (e.g., drought or forest fire): stable regime (perturbations decay and species persist), reactive regime (perturbations are transiently amplified, which increases extinction risk under repeated disturbances), and unstable regime (perturbations grow, causing extinctions even after a single disturbance). Dispersal fundamentally reshapes these stability transitions, converting unstable communities into reactive ones and reactive communities into stable ones. While homogeneous dispersal progressively stabilizes communities, heterogeneous dispersal maximizes stability at intermediate strengths. We further show that habitat loss and fragmentation can be comparably effective at driving species extinctions by shifting metacommunities from stable to reactive and ultimately unstable regimes, demonstrating that fragmentation per se can be as important as habitat loss. Our findings reveal that reactivity is both an early-warning signal of impending instability and a state of elevated extinction risk under recurrent disturbances. By linking stability transitions to changes in population persistence under nonlinear dynamics, our results bridge classical stability theory with spatial ecology and provide a general framework for predicting how ecological complexity and dispersal jointly govern both ecosystem stability and population persistence under habitat degradation.
papers.translated_summary: 栖息地丧失和破碎化正在迅速重塑全球生态系统，然而其对生态稳定性的后果仍未得到解决。由Robert May开创的经典理论建立了严格的稳定性判据；然而，这些判据适用于空间上充分混合的群落，限制了其与栖息地退化的相关性。在此，我们构建了一个集合群落框架，将经典稳定性理论与空间动力学相结合，以确定人为栖息地退化如何重塑生态系统稳定性。我们表明，集合群落在扰动（例如干旱或森林火灾）之后表现出三种不同的动力学 regime：稳定 regime（扰动衰减且物种持续存在）、反应性 regime（扰动被短暂放大，这在反复扰动下增加灭绝风险）以及不稳定 regime（扰动增长，即使在单次扰动后也导致灭绝）。扩散从根本上重塑了这些稳定性转变，将不稳定群落转化为反应性群落，将反应性群落转化为稳定群落。均质扩散逐步稳定群落，而异质扩散在中等强度下使稳定性最大化。我们进一步表明，栖息地丧失和破碎化在驱动物种灭绝方面可以具有相当的效果，其通过将集合群落从稳定 regime 转变为反应性 regime 并最终转变为不稳定 regime 来实现，这表明破碎化本身可以与栖息地丧失同等重要。我们的发现揭示，反应性既是即将发生不稳定的早期预警信号，也是在反复扰动下灭绝风险升高的状态。通过将稳定性转变与非线性动力学下种群持续性的变化联系起来，我们的结果将经典稳定性理论与空间生态学联系起来，并提供了一个通用框架，用于预测生态复杂性和扩散如何在栖息地退化下共同调控生态系统稳定性和种群持续性。

papers.title: Protein language models learn the underlying accessibility of mutations alongside protein fitness landscapes
papers.translated_title: 蛋白质语言模型在蛋白质适应度景观之外还学习了突变的内在可及性
papers.author: MacLean, O. A.
papers.summary: Protein language models (PLMs) score the effects of amino acid replacements as pseudo-probabilities, which are widely utilised to map protein fitness landscapes. However, because their training data relies on natural amino acid sequences, these models conflate protein structural constraints with nucleotide mutation biases and codon accessibility. Using the rapid emergence of the divergent influenza A H3N2 K lineage as a stress test, we investigate how base PLMs (ESM-2 and ESM-C) versus fine-tuned versions of these models capture mutational processes. We systematically implement a parameter sweep to explicitly couple (or decouple) empirical nucleotide mutational supply from PLM-assessed amino acid substitution pseudo-probabilities across evolutionary forecasting tasks. We find that base PLMs implicitly learn generic nucleotide-level mutational constraints, an effect strongly amplified by virus-specific fine-tuning. Incorporating explicit mutational accessibility significantly improves the binary prediction of observed amino acid changes. Conversely, when predicting the final circulating frequency of variants that have already emerged, adding mutational supply degrades performance, confirming that selection dominates post-emergence dynamics. Additionally, we perform amino-acid-level epistatic scanning to investigate protein structural constraints in the context of genetic background. This indicates the improbable antigenic substitution I160K is dependent on co-occurring S144N and N158D mutations in the H3N2 K lineage. Ultimately, current PLM pseudo-probabilities are a composite metric that conflates protein structural fitness with historical biases in mutational supply. Explicitly decoupling these independent evolutionary processes optimises predictive accuracy for real-world pathogen forecasting and isolates pure protein fitness for synthetic design pipelines.
papers.translated_summary: 蛋白质语言模型（PLMs）将氨基酸替换的效应评分为伪概率，这一方法被广泛用于绘制蛋白质适应度景观。然而，由于这些模型的训练数据依赖于天然氨基酸序列，它们将蛋白质结构约束与核苷酸突变偏倚及密码子可及性混为一谈。我们以甲型流感H3N2 K谱系的快速分化出现作为压力测试，研究基础PLMs（ESM-2和ESM-C）与这些模型的微调版本如何捕捉突变过程。我们系统实施参数扫描，在进化预测任务中显式地将经验核苷酸突变供给与PLM评估的氨基酸替换伪概率进行耦合（或解耦）。我们发现基础PLMs隐式学习了通用的核苷酸水平突变约束，而病毒特异性微调强烈放大了这一效应。纳入显式突变可及性显著改善了观察到的氨基酸变化的二分类预测。相反，在预测已出现变体的最终流行频率时，加入突变供给会降低性能，证实选择在出现后动态中占主导地位。此外，我们进行了氨基酸水平的上位性扫描，以研究遗传背景下的蛋白质结构约束。这表明不太可能的抗原性替换I160K依赖于H3N2 K谱系中同时发生的S144N和N158D突变。最终，当前的PLM伪概率是一个复合指标，将蛋白质结构适应度与突变供给的历史偏倚混为一谈。显式解耦这些独立的进化过程可优化真实世界病原体预测的预测准确性，并为合成设计流程分离出纯粹的蛋白质适应度。

papers.title: Novel Regulators of Sugar-dependent Food Consumption in Drosophila melanogaster
papers.translated_title: 果蝇中糖依赖性食物摄入的新型调控因子
papers.author: Opoola, M. A.
papers.summary: Diet and genetic background interact to influence food consumption, yet the genetic basis of diet-dependent feeding behavior remains poorly understood. Here, we used genome-wide association analysis (GWAS) to investigate the genetic regulation of sugar-dependent food consumption in Drosophila melanogaster. Food intake was quantified in 176 lines of the Drosophila Genetic Reference Panel (DGRP) using the Con-Ex (Consumption-Excretion) assay on low- and high-sugar foods. Flies showed compensatory feeding, consuming more low-sugar food than high-sugar food, and this behavior was largely maintained across genotypes. Additionally, the magnitude and overall consumption varied several-fold among lines, with broad-sense heritability of 0.53 to 0.66 across sexes and diets. Association analysis across six sex- and diet-specific phenotypes identified 161 variants mapping to 118 candidate genes, which shared almost no loci between dietary conditions, indicating that consumption on the two foods is largely under separate genetic control. RNAi knockdown of candidate genes identified CG42673 and Tmtc2, whose knockdown increased consumption across sexes and diets and was reproduced in independent experiments. Together, these findings show that natural genetic variation contributes substantially to diet-dependent feeding and identify candidate regulators of sugar-based food consumption in Drosophila.
papers.translated_summary: 饮食与遗传背景相互作用影响食物摄入，然而依赖饮食的摄食行为的遗传基础仍知之甚少。本研究利用全基因组关联分析（GWAS）探究黑腹果蝇中糖依赖性食物摄入的遗传调控。采用Con-Ex（摄入-排泄）测定法，对176个果蝇遗传参考面板（DGRP）品系在低糖和高糖食物上的摄食量进行了定量。果蝇表现出补偿性摄食，即摄入低糖食物多于高糖食物，且该行为在各基因型间基本保持一致。此外，各品系间摄食量的大小和总摄入量存在数倍差异，广义遗传力在性别和饮食间为0.53至0.66。对六种性别和饮食特异性表型的关联分析鉴定出161个变异，映射到118个候选基因，这些基因在两种饮食条件间几乎没有共享位点，表明两种食物上的摄入在很大程度上受独立的遗传控制。对候选基因的RNAi敲低鉴定出CG42673和Tmtc2，其敲低在性别和饮食间均增加摄食量，并在独立实验中得到重复。综上，这些发现表明自然遗传变异对依赖饮食的摄食有实质性贡献，并鉴定了果蝇中糖类食物摄入的候选调控因子。

papers.title: Actin pool controls the scaling of dynamic actin networks
papers.translated_title: 肌动蛋白库控制动态肌动蛋白网络的尺度
papers.author: Cantat, A.
papers.summary: Scaling is a fundamental property of living systems, allowing cells to match the size of their internal components to their volume. The size and shape of cells depend largely on the actin cytoskeleton, whose dynamic self-assembling structures are central to this adaptation. Yet how they self-assemble in a volume-dependent manner remains unresolved. To address this question, we used a biomimetic system consisting of beads propelled by actin polymerization in microwells of different volumes, which allowed us to work with a limited and defined number of components. This approach enabled the first reconstitution, from purified proteins, of dynamic cytoskeletal structures that adapt to the volume of their environment. The scalability of these structures depends on how strongly they deplete monomers from a shared pool, and tuning the disassembly rate is sufficient to shift their scaling regime. Scaling principles also hold for multiple competing structures, with greater competition imposing stronger constraints on the monomer pool. Together, these results establish a mechanistic framework in which a structure's capacity to adapt is set by how much it draws down shared resources as it grows, a principle that may extend to other intracellular structures that scale with the cells that build them.
papers.translated_summary: 尺度缩放是生命系统的基本属性，使细胞能够使其内部组分的尺寸与自身体积相匹配。细胞的大小和形状在很大程度上取决于肌动蛋白细胞骨架，其动态自组装结构是这种适应的核心。然而，它们如何以体积依赖的方式自组装仍未得到解决。为解决这一问题，我们使用了一种仿生系统，该系统由在不同体积微孔中通过肌动蛋白聚合驱动的珠子组成，使我们能够使用数量有限且确定的组分进行研究。这种方法首次实现了从纯化蛋白质出发，重建能够适应其环境体积的动态细胞骨架结构。这些结构的可缩放性取决于它们从共享单体池中耗竭单体的强度，而调节解聚速率足以改变其缩放机制。缩放原理同样适用于多个相互竞争的结构，竞争越激烈对单体池的约束越强。总之，这些结果建立了一个机制框架，其中结构的适应能力由其生长过程中汲取共享资源的多少决定，这一原理可能推广到其他随构建它们的细胞而缩放的细胞内结构。

papers.title: DB-ATRG: The Density and BI-RADS-Aware Triage and Automatic Report Generation System for Mammography
papers.translated_title: DB-ATRG：面向乳腺X线摄影的密度与BI-RADS感知分诊及自动报告生成系统
papers.author: Phan, V.
papers.summary: Background: The growing volume of mammography screenings has created severe radiologist shortages, while standard First-In, First-Out (FIFO) reading queues fail to prioritize urgent or complex cases, delaying critical diagnoses. Objective: This study introduces the Density and BI-RADS--Aware Triage and Report Generation (DB-ATRG) framework to fundamentally restructure mammography workflows by automating diagnostic text generation and enabling risk-based case prioritization. Methods: Utilizing the Digital Mammography Dataset for Breast Cancer Diagnosis Research (DMID), we fine-tuned the 4-billion parameter MedGemma 1.5 vision-language model using Quantization and Low-Rank Adaptation (QLoRA). The extracted biomarkers drive a dual-phase triage algorithm that flags extremely dense breasts (ACR Category D) for supplemental screening and dynamically ranks remaining cases using a calculated Cumulative Urgency Score. The clinical impact of this triage workflow was evaluated against a standard FIFO queue using a simulated cohort of 100 mammography cases. Results: DB-ATRG achieved significant improvements over the AMRG baseline in clinical text generation and classification, securing a ROUGE-L score of 0.8012, a METEOR score of 0.8358, and an ACR Density Accuracy of 0.6810. In clinical simulations, the optimized prioritization queue captured 100.0% of high-risk malignancies (BI-RADS 4 and 5) within the first 20% of the reading workload, compared to just 19.2% in the random FIFO queue. This framework effectively accelerated the mean rank position of severe cases from 42.0 down to 7.5. Conclusion: By accurately automating report generation and aggressively prioritizing severe cases, the DB-ATRG framework can drastically optimize clinical resource allocation and accelerate the time-to-diagnosis for the most vulnerable patients.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：乳腺X线摄影筛查量的不断增长造成了放射科医生的严重短缺，而标准的先进先出（FIFO）阅片队列无法优先处理紧急或复杂病例，从而延误了关键诊断。目的：本研究引入密度与BI-RADS感知分诊及报告生成（DB-ATRG）框架，通过自动化诊断文本生成和实现基于风险的病例优先级排序，从根本上重构乳腺X线摄影工作流程。方法：利用乳腺X线摄影乳腺癌诊断研究数字数据集（DMID），我们使用量化与低秩适配（QLoRA）对40亿参数的MedGemma 1.5视觉语言模型进行了微调。提取的生物标志物驱动一个双阶段分诊算法，该算法标记极度致密乳腺（ACR D类）以进行补充筛查，并使用计算得出的累积紧急度评分对剩余病例进行动态排序。该分诊工作流程的临床影响通过一个包含100例乳腺X线摄影病例的模拟队列与标准FIFO队列进行了评估。结果：DB-ATRG在临床文本生成和分类方面较AMRG基线取得了显著改善，ROUGE-L得分为0.8012，METEOR得分为0.8358，ACR密度准确率为0.6810。在临床模拟中，优化后的优先级队列在阅片工作量的前20%内捕获了100.0%的高风险恶性肿瘤（BI-RADS 4和5），而随机FIFO队列仅为19.2%。该框架有效地将严重病例的平均排名位置从42.0加速至7.5。结论：通过准确自动化报告生成并积极优先处理严重病例，DB-ATRG框架能够大幅优化临床资源配置，并加速最脆弱患者的诊断时间。

papers.title: Genomic epidemiology as a tool for understanding drivers of hepatitis A community outbreaks in Massachusetts and New Hampshire
papers.translated_title: 基因组流行病学作为理解马萨诸塞州和新罕布什尔州甲型肝炎社区暴发驱动因素的工具
papers.author: Krasilnikova, L. A.
papers.summary: Despite the existence of an effective vaccine, the United States continues to experience outbreaks of hepatitis A, including in Massachusetts (MA) and New Hampshire (NH) in 2018 and again in MA in 2023. To clarify the relationship between these outbreaks and better understand their drivers, we generated hepatitis A virus whole genome sequences from reported cases and analyzed them using open-source genotyping tools developed and released as part of this study. We found that the 2018 and 2023 outbreaks were caused by distinct viral strains, despite affecting individuals with similar demographic characteristics and reported risk factors. Detailed analysis of genomic and epidemiologic data further resolved transmission patterns within and across outbreaks, showing that experiencing homelessness and prior use of drugs were associated with increased transmission while also revealing transmission between individuals with and without these risk factors, as well as spread across state borders. Together, these findings demonstrate the value of broadly accessible genomic tools for understanding hepatitis A outbreaks and illustrate how whole genome analysis can complement epidemiological investigation by resolving transmission patterns and outbreak drivers that can inform public health interventions.
papers.translated_summary: 尽管存在有效的疫苗，美国仍持续经历甲型肝炎暴发，包括2018年在马萨诸塞州（MA）和新罕布什尔州（NH）以及2023年再次在马萨诸塞州发生的暴发。为阐明这些暴发之间的关系并更好地理解其驱动因素，我们从报告病例中生成了甲型肝炎病毒全基因组序列，并使用本研究开发并发布的开源基因分型工具对其进行分析。我们发现，2018年和2023年的暴发由不同的病毒株引起，尽管影响的是具有相似人口学特征和报告风险因素的个体。对基因组和流行病学数据的详细分析进一步解析了暴发内部和跨暴发的传播模式，显示无家可归经历和既往药物使用与传播增加相关，同时也揭示了在这些风险因素存在和不存在个体之间的传播，以及跨州界的传播。总之，这些发现证明了广泛可及的基因组工具对于理解甲型肝炎暴发的价值，并说明全基因组分析如何通过解析传播模式和暴发驱动因素来补充流行病学调查，从而为公共卫生干预提供信息。

papers.title: Multi-omics reveals selective metabolic remodelling with trace element supplementation in chronic kidney disease
papers.translated_title: 多组学揭示慢性肾脏病中微量元素补充下的选择性代谢重塑
papers.author: Piao, J.
papers.summary: BackgroundChronic kidney disease (CKD) imposes persistent metabolic stress, yet whether metabolic organization can be preserved under sustained renal stress remains unclear. Essential trace elements support redox defense, mitochondrial function, and intermediary metabolism, and their homeostasis is disturbed in CKD; however, single-element supplementation has yielded heterogeneous results. We examined whether a defined multi-element formulation preserves metabolic resilience in CKD. MethodsIn a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial, 80 maintenance dialysis patients received standard care alone (n = 40) or plus a trace element cocktail (TEX, 20 mL/day; n = 40). Longitudinal trajectories were analyzed with linear mixed-effects models; endpoint plasma metabolomics and fecal metagenomics were profiled in subsets. A 5/6 nephrectomy mouse model was used to quantify plasma tryptophan-pathway branches and renal spatial metabolism by MALDI imaging mass spectrometry. ResultsTEX was well tolerated, with no treatment-related safety signal, and was associated with modestly more favorable creatinine and eGFR trajectories. Supplementation constrained, rather than erased, CKD-associated metabolic displacement (median |Cohens d|, 0.25 versus 2.09 for disease effects), selectively realigning circulating metabolism toward the healthy state. The host kynurenine branch responded most strongly, whereas microbial indole metabolism and gut community structure changed little. Renal metabolic remodeling was region-specific, with preservation of selected tubular and antioxidant features. ConclusionsTrace element supplementation preserved metabolic resilience in CKD, limiting metabolic displacement without complete restoration. Preservation of metabolic organization may represent a complementary dimension of therapeutic response in CKD. Trial registrationInternational Traditional Medicine Clinical Trial Registry, ITMCTR2026000263 (registered 3 February 2026).

papers.title: Self-supervised pretraining for dermoscopic lesion segmentation with limited labels: A controlled comparison of initialisation strategies
papers.translated_title: 有限标签下皮肤镜病变分割的自监督预训练：初始化策略的对照比较
papers.author: Hamda, H. K. H.
papers.summary: BackgroundSelf-supervised learning may improve segmentation when labelled data are limited, but its benefit may depend on model and initialisation strategy. This study evaluated in-domain masked-reconstruction pretraining across limited annotation budgets. MethodsThe International Skin Imaging Collaboration (ISIC) 2016 development set was partitioned into 765 images for self-supervised pretraining, 94 for fine-tuning and 41 for validation. Five nested annotation budgets (12-94 images) and five seeds were evaluated on the 379-image test set. A custom U-Net compared random and in-domain self-supervised initialisation; a ResNet-34 U-Net compared random, ImageNet, in-domain self-supervised and sequential ImageNet-to-self-supervised initialisation. Models trained with 94 labelled images were evaluated without adaptation on ISIC 2017. A separate experiment examined restoration-based pretraining. ResultsIn the custom U-Net, self-supervised pretraining achieved higher mean Dice than random initialisation at all five budgets, including 0.664 versus 0.615 with 12 labels and 0.811 versus 0.768 with 94 labels. Seed-level 95% confidence intervals for paired differences excluded zero at 47 and 94 labels but not at the other budgets. With 47 labels, the self-supervised model achieved mean Dice of 0.789, compared with 0.768 for random initialisation with 94 labels. In ResNet-34, ImageNet initialisation achieved higher mean Dice than in-domain self-supervised pretraining at all five budgets, and adding self-supervised pretraining after ImageNet reduced mean Dice at four of five budgets. All six 94-label configurations achieved lower mean Dice on ISIC 2017 than ISIC 2016. In the restoration experiment, mean Dice was 0.686 with random initialisation and 0.638-0.642 following pretraining. ConclusionsIn-domain masked-reconstruction pretraining improved mean Dice relative to random initialisation in the custom U-Net, but not consistently in the ResNet-34 U-Net, where ImageNet initialisation performed better at every budget. Adding self-supervised pretraining after ImageNet provided no consistent gain. These findings are specific to the dermoscopic lesion-segmentation experiments and do not establish melanoma-specific diagnostic or clinical performance.
papers.translated_summary: 背景自监督学习在标注数据有限时可能改善分割效果，但其收益可能取决于模型和初始化策略。本研究在有限标注预算下评估了域内掩码重建预训练的效果。方法将国际皮肤成像协作组织（ISIC）2016开发集划分为765张图像用于自监督预训练、94张用于微调、41张用于验证。在379张图像的测试集上评估了五个嵌套标注预算（12-94张图像）和五个随机种子。自定义U-Net比较了随机初始化和域内自监督初始化；ResNet-34 U-Net比较了随机、ImageNet、域内自监督以及ImageNet到自监督的序贯初始化。使用94张标注图像训练的模型在无适配情况下于ISIC 2017上评估。另一项独立实验考察了基于复原的预训练。结果在自定义U-Net中，自监督预训练在所有五个预算下均获得高于随机初始化的平均Dice，包括12个标签时的0.664对0.615，以及94个标签时的0.811对0.768。配对差异的种子级95%置信区间在47和94个标签时排除零，但在其他预算下未排除。在47个标签时，自监督模型的平均Dice为0.789，而随机初始化在94个标签时为0.768。在ResNet-34中，ImageNet初始化在所有五个预算下均获得高于域内自监督预训练的平均Dice，且在ImageNet之后添加自监督预训练在五个预算中的四个降低了平均Dice。所有六种94标签配置在ISIC 2017上的平均Dice均低于ISIC 2016。在复原实验中，随机初始化的平均Dice为0.686，预训练后为0.638-0.642。结论在自定义U-Net中，域内掩码重建预训练相对于随机初始化改善了平均Dice，但在ResNet-34 U-Net中并不一致，其中ImageNet初始化在每个预算下表现更好。在ImageNet之后添加自监督预训练未提供一致的增益。这些发现特定于皮肤镜病变分割实验，并不确立黑色素瘤特异性的诊断或临床性能。

papers.title: Evaluating methods to quantify the effect of deprescribing a medication on patient clinical outcomes using a simulation study
papers.translated_title: 评估通过模拟研究量化停用药物对患者临床结局影响的方法
papers.author: Muddiman, R.
papers.summary: Observational studies using electronic health records are being increasingly used to answer research questions of interest in deprescribing, where a medication is intentionally discontinued or the dose reduced. Target trial emulation (TTE) is particularly attractive as it is guided by sound theoretical principles based on causal inference. In the field of deprescribing, the evaluation of TTE within a simulation setting can provide evidence on optimal approaches for implementation and compare different estimation approaches which theory cannot easily inform. Deprescribing studies are susceptible to time-dependent confounding, competing risks due to early adverse events, time-dependent effects and other data complexities which may render estimates biased if such aspects are not properly addressed. In this work, a Monte-Carlo simulation study was conducted to estimate the performance (bias and coverage) of seven methods within several synthetic data generating mechanisms involving the above characteristics. The methods implemented were Cox regression, inverse probability of treatment weighted (IPTW) Cox regression, naive sequential Cox regression, IPTW weighted sequential Cox regression, extended Cox regression and the parametric g-formula. The IPTW Cox regression and IPTW sequential Cox regression were the only methods achieving nominal coverage and unbiasedness under the scenarios evaluated.
papers.translated_summary: 使用电子健康记录的观察性研究正越来越多地被用于回答减药领域中感兴趣的研究问题，即有意停用某种药物或减少剂量。目标试验模拟（TTE）尤其具有吸引力，因为它以基于因果推断的可靠理论原则为指导。在减药领域，在模拟环境中评估TTE可以为实施的最佳方法提供证据，并比较理论难以指导的不同估计方法。减药研究容易受到时间依赖混杂、因早期不良事件导致的竞争风险、时间依赖效应以及其他数据复杂性的影响，如果这些问题未得到妥善处理，可能导致估计产生偏倚。在本工作中，进行了一项蒙特卡洛模拟研究，以估计七种方法在涉及上述特征的若干合成数据生成机制中的性能（偏倚和覆盖率）。所实施的方法包括Cox回归、治疗逆概率加权（IPTW）Cox回归、朴素序贯Cox回归、IPTW加权序贯Cox回归、扩展Cox回归和参数g公式。在所评估的情景中，IPTW Cox回归和IPTW序贯Cox回归是仅有的达到名义覆盖率和无偏性的方法。

papers.title: Micro-fragmented adipose tissue reprogrammes the systemic molecular landscape of inflammatory knee osteoarthritis
papers.translated_title: 微碎片脂肪组织重编程炎症性膝骨关节炎的全身分子景观
papers.author: Primorac, D.
papers.summary: Knee osteoarthritis affects an estimated 374 million people and has no approved disease-modifying treatment. In our double-blind randomised trial (ISRCTN88966184), intra-articular micro-fragmented adipose tissue (MFAT) outperformed hyaluronic acid (HA) on pain, function and cartilage composition, but clinical endpoints alone cannot say whether the disease changed or only the symptoms. Here we answer that question from the blood. Using an interpretable AI data-fusion framework based on non-negative matrix tri-factorisation, we integrated longitudinal plasma proteomics, N-glycomics and miRNA transcriptomics with patient genetics and prior molecular networks at baseline, one and six months, resolving 93 gene and 30 miRNA pathways, almost all significantly enriched in Gene Ontology Biological Process and Reactome annotations. By six months the two injections had left sharply distinct molecular fingerprints. HA remained dominated by canonical OA pathogenesis, including the cartilage-degrading effectors MMP13 and LIMK2 and persistent markers of synovial inflammation. MFAT instead shifted the systemic landscape towards chondroprotection, anti-inflammatory signalling and bone-cartilage homeostasis, prioritising effectors including SIRT7 and NDUFC1. These are, to our knowledge, the first in vivo human data to explain why a regenerative therapy outperforms viscosupplementation in knee osteoarthritis, and they place MFAT on the disease-modifying rather than the symptomatic side of that divide.
papers.translated_summary: 膝关节骨关节炎影响着约3.74亿人，且尚无获批的疾病修饰性治疗。在我们的双盲随机试验（ISRCTN88966184）中，关节腔内注射微碎片脂肪组织（MFAT）在疼痛、功能和软骨成分方面优于透明质酸（HA），但仅凭临床终点无法判断疾病本身是否改变，还是仅症状改善。在此，我们从血液层面回答这一问题。我们采用基于非负矩阵三分解的可解释人工智能数据融合框架，整合了纵向血浆蛋白质组学、N-糖组学和miRNA转录组学数据，并结合患者遗传学信息及既往分子网络，在基线、一个月和六个月时进行分析，解析出93条基因通路和30条miRNA通路，其中几乎所有通路在基因本体生物学过程和Reactome注释中均显著富集。至六个月时，两种注射留下了截然不同的分子指纹。HA仍以经典骨关节炎发病机制为主导，包括软骨降解效应分子MMP13和LIMK2，以及持续的滑膜炎症标志物。而MFAT则将全身分子景观转向软骨保护、抗炎信号传导和骨软骨稳态，优先调控包括SIRT7和NDUFC1在内的效应分子。据我们所知，这是首个人体在体数据，解释了为何一种再生疗法在膝骨关节炎中优于黏性补充疗法，并将MFAT置于疾病修饰而非症状缓解的一侧。

papers.title: Leapfrogging cancer diagnostics with AI: a mixed-methods assessment of implementation determinants in low- and middle-income countries
papers.translated_title: 利用人工智能实现癌症诊断的跨越式发展：对中低收入国家实施决定因素的混合方法评估
papers.author: Schoenpflug, L. A.
papers.summary: Introduction Cancer incidence is rising rapidly in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), where diagnostic pathology capacity is constrained. AI applied to routine histopathology could strengthen diagnostic capacity and offer leapfrogging potential by embedding AI into diagnostic systems as they are built up. However, without empirically identifying implementation determinants in LMIC cancer-diagnostic settings, AI solutions risk being poorly aligned with local constraints, limiting impact or exacerbating existing disparities. Methods We conducted an exploratory mixed-methods pilot study across three phases: 1) a structured survey characterising the diagnostic and technical landscape and AI priorities; 2) focus group discussions (FGDs) to identify implementation determinants and 3) a second survey quantifying FGD-derived themes. Twelve physicians (nine pathologists, three gynaecologists) were purposively recruited (10 LMIC, 2 high-income countries for reference) and findings integrated through narrative triangulation. Results Diagnostic and AI infrastructure varied substantially and did not track consistently with country income classification. H&E staining was universally available, immunohistochemistry capacity was below WHO-recommended capacity for cancer diagnosis at 7 of 10 sites and molecular testing absent or minimal at 6 of 10 sites. Whole-slide-imaging scanners were available at 8 of 10 sites, graphics processing units, required for efficient AI inference, were available at only 4 of 10 sites. Participants prioritised AI for cancer screening, diagnosis, and biomarker prediction from H&E slides. Six implementation determinants were identified: AI literacy, governance frameworks, funding, evidence generation, clinical deployment, and collaboration. Financial constraints emerged as the dominant barrier across all determinants, and collaboration as a key enabler. Conclusion AI implementation readiness varied substantially within income groups, suggesting that country income classification is an insufficient proxy for institutional readiness, underscoring the need for institution-level assessment. Realising the leapfrogging potential of AI in this context requires coordinated progress across all determinants, with sustainable financing, and collaboration as enablers of the other determinants.
papers.translated_summary: 引言 低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs）的癌症发病率正在迅速上升，而这些国家的诊断病理能力受到限制。将人工智能应用于常规组织病理学可以增强诊断能力，并在诊断系统建设过程中嵌入人工智能，从而提供跨越式发展的潜力。然而，如果不以实证方式识别LMIC癌症诊断环境中的实施决定因素，人工智能解决方案就可能与当地限制条件匹配不佳，从而限制其影响或加剧现有差距。方法 我们开展了一项探索性混合方法试点研究，分为三个阶段：1）一项结构化调查，描述诊断和技术环境及人工智能优先事项；2）焦点小组讨论（FGDs），以识别实施决定因素；3）第二项调查，对FGD得出的主题进行量化。我们目的性招募了12名医生（9名病理学家、3名妇科医生）（10名来自LMIC，2名来自高收入国家作为参照），并通过叙事三角互证整合研究结果。结果 诊断和人工智能基础设施差异很大，且与国家收入分类并不一致对应。H&E染色在所有机构均可获得，10个机构中有7个的免疫组织化学能力低于WHO推荐的癌症诊断能力，10个机构中有6个的分子检测缺失或极少。全切片成像扫描仪在10个机构中有8个可用，而高效人工智能推理所需的图形处理器仅在10个机构中的4个可用。参与者优先考虑将人工智能用于癌症筛查、诊断以及基于H&E切片的生物标志物预测。识别出六个实施决定因素：人工智能素养、治理框架、资金、证据生成、临床部署和合作。财务限制成为所有决定因素中的主要障碍，而合作则是关键促进因素。结论 人工智能实施准备度在收入组内部差异很大，表明国家收入分类不足以作为机构准备度的替代指标，凸显了进行机构层面评估的必要性。在此背景下实现人工智能的跨越式发展潜力，需要在所有决定因素上协调推进，并以可持续融资和合作作为其他决定因素的促进因素。

papers.title: Balancing Analgesic Effects and Abuse Liability in Older Adults: A Randomized, Placebo-Controlled Trial of Oral and Vaporized Δ9-Tetrahydrocannabinol
papers.translated_title: 在老年人中平衡镇痛效果与滥用倾向：口服和雾化Δ9-四氢大麻酚的随机安慰剂对照试验
papers.author: Costa, G. P. A.
papers.summary: Cannabis use is rising fastest among older adults in the U.S., and pain is among the most common reasons they use it. No trial, however, has measured the trade-off between the analgesic and abuse-related effects of {Delta}9-tetrahydrocannabinol ({Delta}9-THC) in this population. In a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial, 20 adults aged 65 and older were assigned to oral {Delta}9-THC (placebo, 5, 10 mg) or vaporized {Delta}9-THC (placebo, 2, 4 mg) across three eight-hour sessions in counterbalanced order. We assessed laboratory-evoked pain sensitivity using quantitative sensory testing, abuse liability using subjective drug effects and reinforcement value, and also sampled plasma {Delta}9-THC and 11-OH-THC. Analgesia and abuse liability outcomes were measured repeatedly within each session. On a pain sensitivity index, oral 5 mg relieved pain relative to placebo (p=.040), although the oral arm's overall dose effect was not significant (p=.108); oral 10 mg and both vaporized doses did not differ from placebo. Subjective effects increased with dose and were greatest after vaporization, whereas reinforcement value increased only after vaporized 4 mg. After oral 5 mg, analgesia exceeded placebo at every assessment (60-360 min), while its pleasurable effects peaked at 150 min. Vaporized {Delta}9-THC produced pleasurable effects within 30 min but did not significantly change thermal pain sensitivity. While abuse liability tracked {Delta}9-THC exposure, analgesia showed no significant association, and all adverse events occurred at vaporized 4 mg. These findings suggest dose and route selection may help maximize {Delta}9-THC analgesia while minimizing abuse liability, a strategy that warrants evaluation in clinical populations.
papers.translated_summary: 在美国，大麻使用在老年人中增长最快，而疼痛是他们使用大麻最常见的原因之一。然而，尚无试验在该人群中衡量Δ9-四氢大麻酚（Δ9-THC）的镇痛效应与滥用相关效应之间的权衡。在一项随机、双盲、安慰剂对照试验中，20名65岁及以上成年人按平衡顺序在三次八小时会话中接受口服Δ9-THC（安慰剂、5、10 mg）或吸入Δ9-THC（安慰剂、2、4 mg）。我们使用定量感觉测试评估实验室诱发的疼痛敏感性，使用主观药物效应和强化价值评估滥用倾向，并采样血浆Δ9-THC和11-OH-THC。镇痛和滥用倾向结局在每个会话内重复测量。在疼痛敏感性指数上，口服5 mg相对于安慰剂减轻了疼痛（p=.040），尽管口服组的总体剂量效应不显著（p=.108）；口服10 mg和两种吸入剂量均与安慰剂无差异。主观效应随剂量增加而增强，并在吸入后最强，而强化价值仅在吸入4 mg后增加。口服5 mg后，镇痛在每个评估时间点（60-360分钟）均超过安慰剂，而其愉悦效应在150分钟时达到峰值。吸入Δ9-THC在30分钟内产生愉悦效应，但未显著改变热痛敏感性。滥用倾向与Δ9-THC暴露相关，而镇痛未显示显著关联，所有不良事件均发生在吸入4 mg时。这些发现表明，剂量和给药途径的选择可能有助于最大化Δ9-THC的镇痛效应，同时最小化滥用倾向，这一策略值得在临床人群中评估。

papers.title: Nicotine and Cannabis Co-Use are Associated with Higher Symptom Burden than Use of Either Drug Alone in Early Psychosis: Results from a Multisite Study
papers.translated_title: 尼古丁与大麻共同使用与早期精神病中比单独使用任一药物更高的症状负担相关：一项多中心研究的结果
papers.author: Smucny, J.
papers.summary: Background: Despite their high usage rates and associations with risk for psychosis and earlier age of symptom onset, few studies have examined relationships between nicotine and cannabis co-use and symptoms. Here we examined associations between symptom burden and cannabis/nicotine use/co-use in individuals with early psychosis (EP). Methods: This cross-sectional, multisite cohort study used data from 738 individuals (mean age 22 years, 62% male) from the Early Psychosis Intervention Network (EPI-NET). Relationships between cannabis and/or nicotine use and frequency (over the prior 30 day period) and Modified Colorado Symptom Index (MCSI) scores were examined using mixed effects models, with site as a random factor and age, sex, and cannabis/nicotine use (none, nicotine only, cannabis only, or both) as fixed factors. Exploratory analyses also examined effects of frequency of use (daily vs. less than daily). Results: 59% of the sample used neither nicotine nor cannabis, 17% only nicotine, 9% only cannabis, and 16% both. Significant effects of use were observed on total MCSI score (F = 6.69, p < .001) driven by greater symptoms in individuals who used both cannabis and nicotine relative to neither, only nicotine, or only cannabis. More frequent use, furthermore, was associated with higher total score. Conclusions: These results suggest that co-use of cannabis and nicotine is associated with greater symptom burden in EP, which may have implications for treatment strategies. Neuropharmacological mechanisms that may underlie this association are discussed.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：尽管尼古丁和大麻的使用率较高，且与精神病风险及更早的症状发作年龄相关，但很少有研究考察尼古丁与大麻共同使用与症状之间的关系。本研究考察了早期精神病（EP）个体中症状负担与大麻/尼古丁使用/共同使用之间的关联。方法：这项横断面、多中心队列研究使用了来自早期精神病干预网络（EPI-NET）的738名个体（平均年龄22岁，62%为男性）的数据。采用混合效应模型考察大麻和/或尼古丁使用与使用频率（过去30天期间）及改良科罗拉多症状指数（MCSI）评分之间的关系，以研究站点为随机因素，以年龄、性别和大麻/尼古丁使用情况（均不使用、仅使用尼古丁、仅使用大麻或两者均使用）为固定因素。探索性分析还考察了使用频率（每日使用与非每日使用）的影响。结果：59%的样本既不使用尼古丁也不使用大麻，17%仅使用尼古丁，9%仅使用大麻，16%两者均使用。观察到使用情况对MCSI总分有显著影响（F = 6.69，p < .001），这是由同时使用大麻和尼古丁的个体相对于均不使用、仅使用尼古丁或仅使用大麻的个体症状更严重所驱动的。此外，更频繁的使用与更高的总分相关。结论：这些结果表明，大麻和尼古丁的共同使用与EP中更大的症状负担相关，这可能对治疗策略具有启示意义。本文讨论了可能构成这一关联基础的神经药理学机制。
